p0_issues.title: POST /auth/register has no invite code requirement
p0_issues.description: Any user could register without an invite code, bypassing the invite-only wave control.
p0_issues.fix: RegisterRequest now requires invite_code field. Router validates and atomically redeems the code.

p0_issues.title: POST /mvp/invites has no admin authorization
p0_issues.description: Any unauthenticated request could create invite codes, giving arbitrary users access.
p0_issues.fix: Endpoint now requires Bearer token with is_admin=True via get_admin_user dependency.

p0_issues.title: Invite codes stored as plaintext in mvp_invite table
p0_issues.description: If DB is compromised, all invite codes are immediately usable.
p0_issues.fix: Only SHA-256 hash (code_hash) and 8-char prefix (code_prefix) stored. Plaintext never persisted.

p0_issues.title: No is_admin field on User model
p0_issues.description: Admin authorization had no persistent flag in the database.
p0_issues.fix: is_admin (Boolean, default=false) added to app_users table via migration o3p4q5r6s7t8.

p0_issues.title: MVP tables missing from Supabase (migration never applied)
p0_issues.description: Migrations n2o3p4q5r6s7 and o3p4q5r6s7t8 must be applied to Supabase. Until applied, all MVP endpoints fail with 500.
p0_issues.fix: Run: cd backend && alembic upgrade head
p0_issues.note: Owner must run this against the production Supabase connection string.

non_p0_improvements.title: Login now supports email in the username field
non_p0_improvements.description: If the login value contains '@', it is treated as an email lookup.

non_p0_improvements.title: Separate /mvp/invites/redeem endpoint removed
non_p0_improvements.description: Redemption is now atomic inside POST /auth/register to prevent TOCTOU.

non_p0_improvements.title: Admin CLI create_admin.py for first-admin bootstrap
Admin frontend at /admin/invites
non_p0_improvements.description: Vue SPA for creating, listing, and revoking invite codes.
